mechanism: Infliximab (TNF-alpha inhibitor) increases infection risk and can impair immune function, while isocarboxazid (MAOI) may further compromise immune surveillance and increase risk of serious infections including opportunistic infections.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, closely monitor for signs of infection, ensure tuberculosis screening before infliximab initiation, and consider alternative antidepressants with lower immune-compromising potential.
